author: nero_eth
content:
I looked into engine rpc responses for undecodable bals and only reth and geth returned the correct INVALID. Other clients return -32602. This has been defined in the EIP but not in the execution-apis.

This PR specs it in execution-apis:
https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/869
(find links to PRs against affected clients in the PR too)
